summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch ran an ad for Tom Allen's Free and Easy at 417 Washington Avenue, calling it the best and coolest place of amusement in the city, with the latest songs nightly and the champion keeping order.

metadata.notes: No page image, so masthead and date cannot be checked. The Post-Dispatch did not exist until 1878-12; 1874 Dispatch items are the St. Louis Evening Dispatch (051, the same ad, is from The Dispatch).

facts.fact: Allen advertised Tom Allen's Free and Easy at 417 Washington Avenue as a place of amusement with the latest songs every night, the champion keeping order
